National Security | U.S. Representative Kevin Hern <span style="font-family: Georgia;">A strong national defense strategy is vital to the future of the United States and the safety of our people. As the foremost global superpower, our military superiority secures American stability and provides strength to our allies around the world.&nbsp; In order to keep our people safe from any present or future threat, we must prioritize military preparedness – which means adequate defense funding.&nbsp; Strengthening and modernizing our military is a primary focus. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Georgia;">It’s imperative to continue to combat threats to American security. We have taken the fight to ISIS in Syria, Iraq, Afghanistan and Africa and have made incredible progress to stop the growth of the world’s largest terror organization. In addition, we must condemn Russian encroachment on American sovereignty, and we must be watchful of an emerging China.</span></p>" /> Skip to Content issues National Security Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email A strong national defense strategy is vital to the future of the United States and the safety of our people. As the foremost global superpower, our military superiority secures American stability and provides strength to our allies around the world.  In order to keep our people safe from any present or future threat, we must prioritize military preparedness – which means adequate defense funding.  Strengthening and modernizing our military is a primary focus. It’s imperative to continue to combat threats to American security. We have taken the fight to ISIS in Syria, Iraq, Afghanistan and Africa and have made incredible progress to stop the growth of the world’s largest terror organization. In addition, we must condemn Russian encroachment on American sovereignty, and we must be watchful of an emerging China. Veterans | U.S. Representative Kevin Hern <span style="font-family: Georgia;">Our military men and women put everything on the line to protect our country. In response, it is our duty to support them both in and out of uniform.&nbsp; The men and women who risked their lives to defend our nation deserve excellent care and our utmost respect. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Georgia;">Improving the VA system begins with ending waste and increasing accessibility.&nbsp; An inflated bureaucratic system has made care for our veterans expensive and ineffective.&nbsp; We need to fix the system rather than throwing taxpayer money at the problem.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Georgia;">Additionally, I brought the Veterans History Project to Oklahoma for the first time. The Veterans History Project is a partnership between Congressional offices and the Library of Congress, cataloguing the stories of local veterans to be preserved in Washington, DC, for future generations to see and learn from.</span></p>" /> Skip to Content issues Veterans Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Our military men and women put everything on the line to protect our country. In response, it is our duty to support them both in and out of uniform.  The men and women who risked their lives to defend our nation deserve excellent care and our utmost respect. Improving the VA system begins with ending waste and increasing accessibility.  An inflated bureaucratic system has made care for our veterans expensive and ineffective.  We need to fix the system rather than throwing taxpayer money at the problem. Additionally, I brought the Veterans History Project to Oklahoma for the first time. The Veterans History Project is a partnership between Congressional offices and the Library of Congress, cataloguing the stories of local veterans to be preserved in Washington, DC, for future generations to see and learn from.
